q: Is the rival's work destroyed (T3-006), or is its space taken for the room's own work (T3-061)?
w: Reading A placed T3-006, reader B T3-002. 'Overtake Japan /r/place' proposes taking another room's flag, which T3-061's must_show names in its example 'take over the Hungary flag' (my B1); reader A read the same words as an attack, and T3-006's discriminator turns on whether the space is taken. 'r/place phase 2' names a phase and calls no one, so reader B's T3-002 has no concept its must_show takes.

Reading A placed T3-068, reader B T3-004. 'r/placehearts can't protect the E pixel if only a few people keep changing it to F' turns another room's word into this room's own sign (T3-068, reader A and my B1). T3-004 settles the room's own mark's design, and the HEARTS lettering is placehearts' work, which reader B missed. 'No, it's HEARTS' is one concept from the other side.

Reading A placed T3-005 and flagged a bag, reader B T3-006, T3-005 and T3-081. 'ATTENTION LES ALLEMAND ESSAYENT DE NOUS BOUFFER! VENEZ DEFENDRE LA PATRIE', 'Il faut tenir le drapeau français !', 'Les Italiens essayent de nous piquer notre drapeau au Sud !' and 'Bitcoins are fighting hard, push them back!' answer attacks on the flag (T3-005, all three placements), and lead by count. 'je me sens obligé de leur niquer leur logo', 'LETS TEAR DOWN THE GERMAN FLAG!', 'erasez moi ce bitcoin' and 'r/place RAID' call attacks on other rooms' work (T3-006, reader B). 'Faut faire une ligne Maginot', 'Jour J ?', 'Exécutez l'opération Overlord', 'La France est à moitié occupée ! Nous ne capitulerons pas', 'il faut organiser la résistance' and 'Je vous ai compris! la France résistera!' tell the fight as France's history of war and occupation (T3-081, reader B). Taking German and Italian ground (in reader A's also_present as T3-061) has no placement; three placed acts, so the item is not a bag.

Reading A placed T3-006, reader B T3-005 with a bag. 'THE CELTICS ARE ATTACKING. PUT UP YOUR DEFENSES!!!!!!', 'We are being assaulted!', 'Spurs and Celtics are attacking! I'm on the east-coast and setting up a defense' and 'we have to take back our bottom left corner' answer attacks (T3-005, reader B and my B1), and lead by count. 'We might want t just destroy it', 'Let's light it up' and 'Lol we destroyed their logo' call and report attacks on others' work (T3-006, reader A). 'I will change my heart border to purple if you try to keep the pink space pink' offers a border deal (T3-010, my B1); one concept, alone at its level. Cleaning the bordering hearts, the watch 'all day' and restoring the border design are upkeep, which no placement holds (reader B's also_present T3-021); my B1's T3-141 has no concept, since no watch names hours or sleep.

Both readers placed T3-006. 'It'd be nice if we could use it to put some other groups down' proposes using the room's heart against other groups' work (T3-006). My B1's T3-086 needs the community's own quarrel, and none is named.

Reading A placed T3-006, reader B T3-006 and T3-068. '¿Debería sabotearles la bandera a los finos?', 'Vamos a invadir brasil muchachos', 'la otra mitad arruinando la de Brasil', 'hay que ponerle un 7-1 en la bandera de brasil', 'Tenemos q hacerlo parecer una invasión mexicana', the Hitler moustache painted on entering and 'Quitemos los ojos de Chavez de abajo!' call and carry out attacks on other rooms' flags (T3-006, all three placements), and lead by count. 'Nuevo objetivo detectado. Pintar la bandera argentina en la de Brasil', 'pintemos la de argentina arriba de brasil' and 'pudimos hacer una bandera argentina adentro de la brazilera' turn Brazil's flag into Argentina's sign (T3-068, reader B). The calls against a Paraguayan 'invasion' and the Void, and 'cuck holandeses', 'Llamen a Maxima!' and 'TRIPLE ALIANZA INTENSIFIES', are left out.

q: Is the rival's work destroyed (T3-006), or is its space taken for the room's own work (T3-061)?
w: Both readers put T3-006 first. 'I say we invade their flag. They already have the top red, so we turn the white blue and blue Orange', 'lets take over turkey. Take revenge!', 'Why don't you guys just take over turkey' and 'go replace the Turkish flag with yours, much better spot' take another room's flag for the room's own, which T3-061's must_show names ('take over the Hungary flag', my B1); T3-006's discriminator asks whether the rival's work is destroyed or its space taken, and the words take the space. 'INPOLDEREN', posted twice, and the Wilhelmus posted by Dutch members in r/armenia's thread are a raid chorus (T3-134, my B1). 'Zweer trouw aan uw nieuwe Koninkrijk!' and 'God damn colonists' tell the takeover as colonial history (T3-081, reader B); two concepts, alone at their level. 'The Dutch have declared an outright invasion' (reader A's T3-073) is one concept, cut by the limit of three.

Reading A placed T3-006, reader B T3-006, T3-061 and T3-005. 'Que tal nós arruinarmos a bandeira da argentina', 'Bora fazer um pinto no lugar do sol', 'Lets paint N4z1 symbols in the German flag!', 'VAMOS ESCREVER Pelé > Maradona NA BANDEIRA DOS HERMANOS!!!', 'Vamos Invadir a Argentina' and 'Apaga todas menos a nossa' call to deface and erase other rooms' flags (T3-006, all three placements), and lead by count. 'Brasileiros, uni-vos! Nossa bandeira está sendo atacada', 'O VOID CHEGOU! PROTEJAM A BUNDA E NOSSA BANDEIRA!' and 'Precisamos combater primeiro os boludos que estão escrevendo 7x1 na nossa bandeira' answer attacks (T3-005, reader B). 'vamos fazer a bandeira do Brasil por cima da bandeira da Argentina', 'substituir ela pela nossa', annexing 'a Argentina e a Finlândia' and invading Argentina for a flagpole take its space for Brazil's flag (T3-061, reader B), by the T3-006|T3-061 paragraph. Expanding the green right and down names no neighbour and is left out.

Both readers placed T3-006. 'Let's make this on the UK flag in r/place show them what's up' puts an image over another room's flag as a challenge (T3-006). '180, 340 sorta' gives coordinates (my B1's T3-070), one concept with one placement against T3-006's two, so it is not kept; my B1's T3-033 needs a mark for the room, and this one is aimed at the UK flag.

Both readers placed T3-006. 'I'm content just pissing off flames fans by ruining their fun' and 'just stirring up a little bit of a rivalry with the flames fan base' report and defend the raid on the Flames' mark (T3-006). My B1's T3-124 weighs fighting against moving, and no move is weighed. Mocking builders, laughing at the Flames' reactions and the apology to Calgary are left out.

Reading A placed T3-006 and T3-192, reader B T3-006. Turning the Cubs logo into 'Cubsuck', 'Cobs', 'Cucs' and 'Cocks', 'We have achieved COBS', 'I think it did say cocks for a few seconds' and the glitch that 'got it to say cocks' change letters into jokes for amusement (T3-192, reader A), and lead by count; T3-006's must_not_show sends griefing for fun to T3-192. 'Destroy the Cubs logo on r/place!!!', 'Help us Indians fan's destroy the Cubs logo' and turning it 'completely red' call to destroy a rival's mark (T3-006, all three placements). '#TAKE THAT YOU DIRTY CUBS FANS' and naming them 'the Cues' taunt the rival (T3-050, my B1); two concepts, alone at their level. 'Not sure I like place' (my B1's T3-037) is cut by the limit of three.

Reading A placed T3-006, T3-061 and T3-068, reader B T3-006. 'BINNENVALLEN DIE HANDEL' (invade that lot), 'ER IS ZOJUIST EEN OORLOG VERKLAARD MET ZWEDEN', 'AANVALLEN!' and an attack on Singapore's flag call attacks on others' work (T3-006, readers A and B), and lead by count. 'Annexeer Armenië!', 'DE GRIEKEN ZIJN NAAR BED ANEXEER ANEXEER ANEXEER', a petition to annex Czechia and a 'strategisch plan' for colonisation take neighbours' ground (T3-061, reader A), by the T3-006|T3-061 paragraph. 'Maak de Turkse vlag oranje!', 'Maak Kroatië Nederland again' and 'PCMASTERRACE in BEEMSTERKAAS' turn others' work into the Dutch sign (T3-068, reader A and my B1). 'Verdelg Erdogan' (exterminate Erdogan) and 'MH17' written on a Russian flag (my B1's T3-130), and the Ottomans (my B1's T3-081), are cut by the limit of three; 'kutgrieken' (cunt Greeks) is one concept.

Reading A placed T3-006 and T3-041, reader B T3-006. 'I've been trying to fuck up your CLG all day', 'A TSM fan recruited me for the cause', 'Can we destroy TSM in r/place?' and the Danes who 'obliterated' the TSM logo call and report attacks on rival marks (T3-006, all three placements), and lead by count. 'FREESM + CLG logo on /r/place!', 'Get rid of the FREESM' and 'focus on maintaining the logo first and only working on freesm when the logo is perfect' add a piece beside the room's mark (T3-041, reader A and my B1). 'TSM logo. Disgusting.', 'the simple fanaticism of us CLG fans ensured a loss on your part' and 'your mom's a hoe' taunt the rival community (T3-050, my B1). TSM's losses and its new logo are reports no placement holds.

Reading A placed T3-006, reader B T3-006 and T3-068. 'I'm currently attempting to turn it into the green anarchist flag', 'Only a matter of time until we can completely take over the propertarians' flag', 'We're taking over no step on snek', 'I just made it do step on snek', the propertarian flag 'starting to get really red' and 'We've already seized one flag' turn rivals' flags into the room's own signs (T3-068, reader B and my B1), and lead by count. 'Sabotage the swastikas', 'I trashed the Islamophobic cult', 'we should try and vandalize the american flag', '(turn it pink)' and 'SHATTER THE DIAMONDS' call and report attacks on others' work (T3-006, readers A and B). Defending the flag from ancaps and 'fash' swastikas, restoring it and the glitch used for more pixels are acts no placement holds.

Both readers placed T3-006 and flagged a bag. 'Let's do the good ol' 68 on them. Now with the sides reversed', 'We need to invade Russia and erase them', 'Join me in destroying the Hammer And Sickle!', 'Let's invade Philippines!' and 'Texas shall fall' call attacks on others' work (T3-006), and lead by count. 'If we grow 3 pixels taller, we can take over Russia', 'we should annex and connect the beer' and 'Annexeren!' take neighbours' ground (T3-061, my B1). 'Edit: do not invade. The guys are cool.' and 'You are cruel. Some people worked on that.' call an attack off after an objection (T3-076, my B1); two concepts, alone at their level. 'The Hammer and Sickle is a symbol of murder, totality and occupation for many Czechs' argues a political symbol (my B1's T3-080), one concept cut by the limit of three; the readers' T3-024 under also_present has no placement. Three placed acts, so the item is not a bag.

Reading A placed T3-006, T3-061 and T3-177, reader B T3-006 and T3-177. 'DEATH TO BLUE', 'We have to raid the r/furry spot', 'lets delet it', 'lets hunt some furries', 'Change Colombia to columbine!!' and a threat to 'recreate 9/11' call attacks on others' work (T3-006, all three placements), and lead by count. 'LET'S MAKE A SWASTIKA OVER ON R/PLACE', twice, 'lets make a swastika on r/place' and swastikas with 'Hitler's face on top of OSU' call to draw Nazi images (T3-177, all three placements). 'Anyone fancy taking over this blue corner', 'Lets destroy the logo and take our spot' and 'Let us take over the Croatian fascists in r/place!' take others' space for the room (T3-061, reader A).

Reading A placed T3-006, reader B T3-006, T3-068 and T3-041. 'Vi må udviske svensken!' (we must erase the Swede), 'Destruerer det blå hjørne!', 'Angreb på svenskens hjerte', 'Vi angriber Tennesee kl.15:30!' and 'Vi erobrer Norge klokken 16!' call attacks on others' work (T3-006, readers A and B), and lead by count. 'Vi kan gøre det norske flag dansk ved at måle hvidt over den blå', 'HELP MAKE THE SWEDISH FLAG DANISH', making the union heart 'til et Dansk hjerte' and 'lav det danske flag ud af det østrigske flag' turn others' flags into Dannebrog (T3-068, reader B and my B1). 'Aktion kl. 18 for at udvide det danske flag!!', completing the rectangle of tiny Danish flags and 'Uden en betydelig indsats kan vi nemt udvide Dannebrog' grow the room's own work (T3-041, reader B). Retaking 'olien' and the state before 1814 is one concept.

Reading A placed T3-006 and T3-050, reader B T3-006. 'I've been trying to destroy Tennessee's', a blue border around their T, 'go fuck up the FSU logo', a Gator logo over LSU and 'We need to wipe them out as soon as they get going' call and report attacks on rival marks (T3-006, readers A and B), and lead by count. Adding '11-1' next to the F 'so that we can tease /r/ockytop', 'It lasted almost as long as their chance as of winning the East' and mocking a rival's banner of destroyed pieces taunt the rival (T3-050, reader A). My B1's T3-086 names the community's rivalry carried onto the canvas; T3-086's must_not_show sends taunts traded with a rival community to T3-050, and the attacks are T3-006, so T3-086 has no concept of its own (conflict CC-042).

Reading A placed T3-006, reader B T3-006 and T3-068. 'Let's turn the Bears logo on r/place into the Pack logo', 'can we delete and replace with the G?', 'turn it into a packers logo like the champions we are' and 'needs to be Packerized' turn the rival's mark into the room's sign (T3-068, reader B and my B1), and lead by count. 'Check out the Bears logo on /r/place' and Finland 'abolishing the Bears from their territory' point at and celebrate the attack (T3-006, all three placements); two concepts, alone at their level. 'Let's help Finland draw their flag over them' sends the room to another room's work (T3-011, my B1); one concept, alone at its level. 'BEARS SUCK!' between the Packers and the Vikings and 'just some friendly nfc north competition' are left out.

Both readers placed T3-006 and T3-076. 'Trogdor is currently burninating the green thing to his right', 'It's time to burninate the peasantry', 'I'm trying to burn the achievement hunter logo' and 'The Homestarmy must invade Austria!' call attacks on others' work (T3-006), and lead by count. 'can you not', 'it is probably best if we don't piss off another group of people by burninating the Achievement Hunters' logo' and 'Stop burninating Achievement Hunter, dammit!' rein in the room's own attack (T3-076). 'We need to expand Trogdor into achievement hunter!' and fire 'from his mouth overlapping the /r/Achievement_Hunter logo' grow the room's work into a neighbour's space (T3-061, my B1); two concepts, alone at their level, so my T3-061 is kept beside the readers' themes.

Reading A placed T3-006 and T3-061, reader B T3-006. 'All out war on /r/place', 'Battle plan against india', 'Homestuck on India', 'We must white out nearby things to claim dominance' and 'Should we formally attack the Flowey?' call attacks on others' work (T3-006, all three placements), and lead. 'The corners are made for us!' and expanding the sub name downwards 'Since pi underneath us is going down' take a neighbour's space (T3-061, reader A and my B1); two concepts, alone at their level. 'keep expanding the blue border' names no neighbour and is left out.

Both readers placed T3-006. 'Take up arms boys! We're going raiding!', 'STELUM BRETLANDI!' (let's steal Britain), 'We wanted to steal the Union Jack' and 'Tillaga að ráðast inn í filippseyjar' (a proposal to invade the Philippines) call raids on others' work (T3-006), and lead. 'Britain will be Norse again' and 'Ireland was always a Viking raiding target!' (my B1's T3-081) and changing the Norwegian flag to Icelandic with 'Stop changing Ireland to Iceland!!' (my B1's T3-068) tie at two concepts with one placement each, so neither is kept, and the tie ends the order there: another Icelandic flag beside EVE (my B1's T3-041) is not kept either.

Reading A placed T3-006 and T3-061, reader B those and T3-076. 'Let's take a corner on r/place!', 'I am going to make an Irish flag over the UK flag', 'Let us erase the UK flag from r/Place and replace it with the tricolour!', 'Can we just all attack the Italian flag and claim that?', 'The heart closest to the flag would be easier to take over' and 'Rock up to the border in friendship then takeover when the Americans go to sleep' take neighbours' ground for the tricolour (T3-061, all three placements), and lead by count, by the T3-006|T3-061 paragraph. 'Let's stop the UK flag from finishing', 'remember to block out all the union jacks', 'Comrades, please help /r/Wales and /r/Scotland to destroy the Union Jack', 'remove Northern Ireland from the Union Jack' and 'Write IRA on the English flag boiz!' call attacks on others' work (T3-006, readers A and B). 'There's a mega thread + no hijacking! We're neutral', 'Ireland should have no part in a plot to attack America' and 'don't attack The Fucking USA ... We don't have the manpower' rein in the room's attacks (T3-076, reader B).

Reading A placed T3-006, reader B T3-006 and T3-076. 'Can you guys go fuck up the habs logo in r/place?', 'Ours is fucked, let's take them down too', 'Payback time' with coordinates, 'Screw up the flames logo', 'WE MUST CRUSH THE VIKING SHIP!' and 'let's bring all the nhl teams together to annihilate russia' call attacks on rival marks (T3-006, all three placements), and lead by count. 'How about we just work on our own and not be assholes', 'Leave the Russians alone', 'Don't be a dick, let them have it as LAINE', 'building and maintaining is more important than petty destroying' and 'Don't go and mess up the Habs logo, just focus on getting ours done' rein in the room's attacks (T3-076, reader B).

Reading A placed T3-006, reader B T3-006, T3-068 and T3-046. 'this is our calling. Stealing the work of others and getting fame for it', 'bringing up the moral high ground card in r/place', 'I just don't see the apeal in ruining other people pride', 'It's all light hearted fun bro, chill' and 'what is light hearted about destroying pixel art because you dislike a country?' argue whether taking others' work is fair (T3-046, reader B), and lead by count. 'help us steal the Austrian flag', 'Let's turn the canadian flag into the lebanese flag', 'I already took over Austria's and Israel's' and 'This flag could be an easy target and requires a small tree' turn red-white-red flags into the Lebanese flag (T3-068, reader B). 'We must launch a full scale attack on all flags', 'you are focusing on attacking the Israeli flag' and 'people were non-stop griefing it' call and report attacks (T3-006, readers A and B); they tie my B1's T3-061 at six concepts ('How about we build it on top of the Israeli one?', 'Let's take over the Hungary flag', taking 'as much as hearts as possible') and lead it on placements, so T3-061 is cut by the limit of three.
